system.description:
You begin to collect and manifest a bright chakra until it laces the striking portion of your weapon, causing it to shine, like the rising sun. This chakra then begins to glow brightly with enough intensity to dispel any chakra based or natural darkness until the end of your current turn leaving a hazy illusion of all movement you make.

Until the beginning of your next turn this hazy light released affects all creatures of your choice within 15 feet of you, imposing the following effects;

Selected creatures suffers a -6 penalty to attacks made against you as their combat instincts are dulled.

Select creatures cannot gain Jutsu based bonuses to their Attacks, Save DC’s or AC.

Chain 3: The next Bukijutsu you cast with the Chain keyword before the end of your next turn, can gain the benefits of any 2 Chain effects listed.
